newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Battle Australian gold mine approved.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Battle Australian gold mine approved.

text.p: Battle Mountain Gold Co said on Wednesday that final approval had been granted for development of the US$40 million Vera-Nancy gold project in Queensland.
Production from the project, a 50-50 joint venture with Normandy Mining Ltd, should begin early next year, Battle Mountain said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
The company also said commercial production had commenced at its 84.6 percent-owned Holloway gold mine in Ontario, Canada.

Mining from the small Vera open pit section is underway, with ore being stockpiled, Battle Mountain said. Full production from the underground ore was anticipated by August 1997 at an annual rate of about 100,000 ounces, the company said.

Plans currently call for the mine to produce about 30,000 attributable ounces for Battle Mountain in 1997, at an estimated average production cost of US$190.00 per gold ounce sold and a total operating cost of about US$255.00 an ounce, it said.

By 1998, Battle Mountain said its share of production from the mine was targeted at about 50,000 ounces, with cash costs seen declining to about US$150.00 and total costs to US$190.00 an ounce. The mine will be operated by Normandy.

At the Holloway mine, located in northeastern Ontario, about 23,000 attributable ounces are expected to be produced this year, with ongoing production attributable to the company of 90,000 ounces annually, Battle Mountain said.
Overall, Battle Mountain expects to produce about one million ounces of gold in 1997, up from a forecast 960,00 ounces this year, the company said.
Total cash operating costs are put by the company at at about US$143 an ounce in 1997 against US$214.00 this year.
Next year, Houston-based Battle Mountain said it expects to fund a US$35 million exploration programme covering some 75 projects in 13 countries.
Battle Mountain also said that the transition following its US$1.5 billion merger with Canada's Hemlo Gold Mines Inc in July was progressing well.
